kind_why: A combat surf map: built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.
author: smooth
notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones: a combat surf map with no finish (see maps/zones/README.md). A bathroom-scale combat surf: 32 placed weapons, and every teleport aims at a team's spawn (tele_dest_t1/ct1/ct2) or the top -- no line to time. gb-maps-1 batch of 2026-10-09. Not published.
